threat_event: A leaked static machine credential lets an attacker read customer exports and payroll handoff files across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1,140 static cloud keys (212 older than 1 year); 37 consulting toolkit keys read every tenant export prefix; handoff files kept 400+ days with provider-managed keys and no read logging
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 export bucket; SYS-D2 migration toolkit; SYS-D3 handoff intake
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 3); N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(c)(3); (c)(6)); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: Secret scanning on group repositories; encryption at rest; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Workload identity for all integrations and a guardrail against new static keys; dedicated handoff channel with 7-day retention, customer-managed keys, and read logging; bulk-read detection

threat_event: Ransomware or a destructive attack spreads through shared identity, CI/CD, or the consulting access gateway into several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and CI/CD connect all divisions; the acquired consulting firm has no group EDR; consultants reach client environments
regulatory_driver: N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(h)); N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); client contracts
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on group endpoints and workloads; PAM; immutable backups in provider B
treatment_plan: Bring the acquired firm onto group EDR and identity; isolate the client access gateway; cross-division restore exercise

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more customer, bank, regulator, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Matrix lacks FTC Safeguards notices, bank-designated contacts (164 of 420 missing), 48-hour customer terms, and sponsor bank 24-hour terms; never exercised across divisions
regulatory_driver: N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(j)); 12 CFR 53.4; N51-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); DPA terms
existing_controls: Group incident plan; disclosure committee charter; outside breach counsel
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-division matrix (P08); collect bank contacts; cross-division tabletop 2026-12-08

threat_event: AI in products and in group HR produces unfair, inaccurate, or undisclosed outcomes
threat_source: AI model error and governance gaps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Attrition-risk insights and the workforce assistant launched before the Group AI Standard; no bias testing; resume screening pilot without an ADMT assessment
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 AI services; group HR resume screening; payments risk models
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (deception and unfairness); N51-R03 (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, ADMT); Colo. SB26-189
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026-06-15); Group AI council
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program conditions (P10): bias testing, developer documentation, ADMT assessment, change gate

threat_event: Consultant or support access to customer tenants is misused or compromised
threat_source: Insider; attacker using a consultant identity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3,800 consultants hold implementation-partner access; access stays after project close (about 1,100 tenants); credentials kept in project notes
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 2); DPA terms
existing_controls: Single sign-on with MFA; tenant access logged
treatment_plan: Time-boxed, ticket-linked partner access that expires at project close; certification of partner roles; vault for client credentials

threat_event: Workers' pay is diverted through direct deposit change fraud or tampering with handoff files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Account changes in the self-service app need only re-authentication; handoff files are writable by the export role
regulatory_driver: N52-R03 (16 CFR 314.4(c)(1)); state wage payment laws (generic)
existing_controls: Re-authentication for changes; signed handoff files; payroll anomaly model
treatment_plan: Notify workers through a second channel on bank changes; hold first pay to a new account when risk signals fire

threat_event: A group identity outage stops all three divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Every console and cloud account federates to SYS-G1
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts tested quarterly; vendor multi-region service
treatment_plan: Keep; add break-glass for the payroll engine operators

threat_event: A critical third party fails (cloud provider A region, sponsor bank A, the model provider, the identity vendor)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration on a few providers; exit plans exist only for the cloud providers
existing_controls: Annual vendor reviews; contracts with notice terms
treatment_plan: Contingency sponsor bank agreement; model provider fallback; vendor tabletop

threat_event: Affiliate service relationships run without agreements or oversight
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The WCP stores Payments and Payroll customer information without an intercompany agreement; the division's written risk assessment omits the flow
existing_controls: Group third-party policy; intercompany services agreement for checkout (2024)
treatment_plan: Intercompany agreement with safeguards terms; include affiliates in the division risk assessment and vendor oversight

threat_event: The acquired consulting firm's separate stack becomes the entry point for an attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2,600 laptops without group EDR; separate identity provider outside certification; VPN without device checks
existing_controls: Legacy antivirus; MFA on the acquired identity provider
treatment_plan: Accelerate EDR rollout to 2026-11-30; migrate identities by 2027-03-31
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: The payroll funds flow is found to need money transmitter licenses the division does not hold
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: State-by-state licensing analysis not complete; federal status depends on facts and circumstances (31 CFR 1010.100(ff)(5)(ii))
existing_controls: Funds held only in sponsor bank FBO accounts; outside counsel engaged
treatment_plan: Complete the licensing analysis and decide on licenses or program changes
owner: Payments and Payroll chief compliance officer

threat_event: PCI DSS compliance lapses and the sponsor bank or card networks impose conditions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Six-monthly segmentation test missed; checkout script inventory incomplete
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 11.4.6; 6.4.3; sponsor bank B contract
existing_controls: Annual ROC by a QSA; separate CDE accounts
treatment_plan: Run the missed segmentation test; complete script inventory and tamper detection

threat_event: Malicious code enters the WCP, payroll engine, or payments platform through the build pipeline or a dependency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared CI/CD; many open-source dependencies
existing_controls: Signed builds; dependency scanning; protected branches
treatment_plan: Build provenance attestations; dependency allow-lists for payment and payroll code

threat_event: The disclosure committee delays or mis-states a materiality determination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cross-division incidents are hard to size; the role of customer and bank trust in materiality is not yet worked through
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cybersecurity; outside counsel
treatment_plan: Materiality factor worksheet in P08; exercise in the tabletop

threat_event: The group is not ready for its first CCPA cybersecurity audit (period starting 2027-01-01)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No auditor selected; no audit scope; evidence spread across three divisions
existing_controls: SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 evidence for the WCP
treatment_plan: Select an independent auditor; map the 7123 components to existing evidence; dry run in 2027 Q2

threat_event: Federal contract information is mishandled and an agency finds the FAR clause unmet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI mixed with commercial projects; 9 of 22 subcontracts lack flowdown
existing_controls: Group security program meets most basic safeguarding controls
treatment_plan: Separate federal project area; flowdown amendments
owner: Technology Consulting federal contracts compliance officer

threat_event: A vendor or sub-processor gives a covered person access to bulk U.S. sensitive personal data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor screening asks about location but not ownership by covered persons
existing_controls: No offshore hosting; vendor location screening
treatment_plan: Add covered-person and ownership questions to vendor onboarding and annual review

threat_event: Clients and auditors cannot rely on consulting's use of group controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Common control inheritance not documented for consulting
existing_controls: Group common control catalog
treatment_plan: Consulting inheritance matrix and annual confirmation
owner: Technology Consulting security and compliance lead

threat_event: Loss of key security and platform staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Specialist knowledge concentrated in a few engineers in each division
affected_asset_or_process: SOC; WCP platform team; payroll engine team
existing_controls: Succession plans for executives
treatment_plan: Succession plans one level down; runbooks for key platform functions

threat_event: A provider A regional outage takes down the WCP and embedded checkout pages
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby region failover tested yearly; payroll dependency not in the test
existing_controls: Warm standby region; continuous replication
treatment_plan: Joint failover test with the payroll engine; checkout fallback pages hosted in provider B
